title: Inline formatting, roles, and emoji
text: # MPD Markdown Use _emphasis_, *strong text*, and *_strong emphasis_* with `inline code`. Roles include @mark[marked], @delete[removed], @sub[2], @sup[n], and @key[Command K]. Ship :rocket: with :sparkles:. Unknown :not_an_emoji: and escaped \:rocket: remain text. Code `:rocket:` remains literal. Use *emphasis*, **strong text**, and ***strong emphasis*** with `inline code`. Roles include <mark>marked</mark>, ~~removed~~, H<sub>2</sub>O, x<sup>n</sup>, and <kbd>Command K</kbd>. Ship 🚀 with ✨. Unknown :not_an_emoji: and escaped :rocket: remain text. Code `:rocket:` remains literal. Expected HTML Use emphasis , strong text , and strong emphasis with inline code . Roles include marked , removed , H 2 O, x n , and Command K . Ship 🚀 with ✨. Unknown :not_an_emoji: and escaped :rocket: remain text. Code :rocket: remains literal. Links · top
